crossRefs.note: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes…
Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of…
The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.
Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.
Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the…
to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive…

translations.web: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
translations.bsb: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.
translations.kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
translations.asv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a demon, blind and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the dumb man spake and saw.
